verdict: The frozen production candidate has one concrete whole-tree cross-check blocker: a patched stdlib object containing a str subclass key is accepted, and a hostile str subclass can execute __eq__ and leak a raw AssertionError. R1 requires unsupported stdlib types to become CODE_CONFIG_PARSER_MISMATCH. The R3 clarification is semantically aligned as a correction draft, but the proposed R3 test patch is not ready: its source-anchor parity call rejects BOM/bare-CR vectors through the legacy text helper, and it omits the stdlib-key/callback and explicit no-source-echo regressions. No source, test, fixture or Git state was changed.

contract_binding.requirement: A scanner-accepted stdlib rejection or unsupported stdlib type is CODE_CONFIG_PARSER_MISMATCH; compare the full key set and exact decoded tree without ordinary equality weakening.
